name: Jason P.
quote: Captain Frankie provided an outstanding fishing experience for my family.  He went above and beyond to make our trip outstanding.  Created  memories that will last a lifetime. 80 pound bull shark landed and a big one that got away!

name: Chelsey H.
quote: Captain Rob gave us an amazing experience had so much fun. He knew right where to take us so we could catch plenty of fish!!! Would recommend him to anyone and we will be going again in the near future

name: Darby L. H.
quote: They were very accommodating as we booked our trip last minute when we passed through the area, but they made it happen for us on short notice. Also, water conditions were less than ideal and abnormally cold and although the fish weren't biting great the captain tried multiple locations and different baits until we started catching some. My son had a memorable 12th birthday. He'll never forget catching a shark!

name: Xella D.
quote: We booked a last minute fishing trip two days before Christmas and had a great time! Caught enough fish to feed the whole family for Christmas dinner

name: Randy P.
quote: Captain Ashmore did a fantastic job of putting us on the fish all day long! He was so very accommodating and personable. He kept everyone engaged with his knowledge of Tampa Bay and its ecosystem. We were all so very impressed! And!!! We caught so many huge fish!!!!!! We have so many awesome family photos and memories that will last a lifetime!!!!

name: Kyle N.
quote: Captain Frankie with FG Charters gave us an unforgettable day on the water! He took me and my two nephews out fishing, and we had an absolute blast. Not only is he super knowledgeable and professional, but he's also great with kids and kept them engaged and excited the whole time. We ended up catching over 80 fish! It was non-stop action, and the boys haven't stopped talking about it since. If you're looking for a top-notch fishing experience, look no further. FG Charters is the real deal. Thanks, Captain Frankie!

name: Davi C.
quote: 11/10 experience!! Captain took us to all his best spots and it was fish on every stop we did !! we had lotta variety of bait to make sure we can catch whatevar was out there. WOULD DEF RECOMMEND

name: Kim H.
quote: We went out this weekend with Frankie on our vacation to Clearwater. You can tell Frankie knows the bay like the back of his hand, as he shared with us that he was born and raised in the area. We had a blast and caught so many fish we lost count with 11 being keepers. Thank you Captain Frankie for filling our freezer and giving us great memories.

name: Guest
quote: Lots of knowledge with a calm cool demeanor. Caught fish all day every spot we stopped at! Great trip, highly recommend.

name: Dennis R.
quote: Went out today with Frankie at FG Charters and had an epic day….after getting tired of catching Redfish, I finally got my first legal slot snook in 7 years!!! Always a great time at FG Charters

name: Nataliya D.
quote: Captain Frankie gave us a fantastic day on the water! My teenage son and I booked a charter in Tampa Bay and had a blast—we each caught 6 fish, released most, but kept a couple nice ones. Frankie's boat is super comfortable, and he knew exactly where to go for the best chances. He's friendly, easygoing, and made the experience fun and stress-free for both of us. It's clear he loves what he does, and it shows in how much effort he puts into making the trip great. We'll definitely be booking again next time we're in Florida!

name: Betty S.
quote: Best Captain on the Bay. We had a great charter with Frankie on our vacation and caught so many fish. Even got to take 11 fish home to eat. Thank you Frankie! We will be back

name: Kelly L.
quote: Fishing Adventure from Minnesota to Florida! We had an incredible fishing trip, thanks to Captain Frankie! From start to finish, Captain Frankie showed us the ropes and made the experience one our kids will never forget. The kids loved every moment, and we were able to catch some amazing fish along the way. Frankie's expertise and friendly approach made the whole trip enjoyable for everyone. Highly recommend this adventure for anyone looking to make lasting memories. Thumbs up!!

name: Bruce
quote: Thanks Captain Frankie for the great time we had fishing with you. You put us on many fish, we did catch a few which were great. Can't wait to do it again I don't have pictures but what we did land was a lot of fun.  Thanks for the great time.

name: Brooksville Logistics
quote: Extremely knowledgeable captain. We've been out multiple times with capt Frankie. He has us on our targeted species on every trip. Friendly and accommodating.

name: Jon L.
quote: Went on a trip with Captain Frankie and it was an awesome day on the water.  Caught lots of fish.  Captain was attentive and helpful and a hard worker .  Captain worked hard to keep us on active fish.  Would highly recommend.  Captain was definitely dialed in on the fish.   Five  Stars!

name: Samar
quote: Hands down the best fishing charter! Frankie was great and my son is super happy. Highly recommended.

name: Ashley H.
quote: Absolutely recommend booking with FG charters! You're going to catch fish when out with Frankie, he knows what he's doing and will get you set up and hookin up fish in no time. We had a great time out on the water thanks to Frankie.

name: Dawn R.
quote: Had a great time.  Frankie put us on to a lot of fish.  Caught a ton of grunts and some grouper.  He is very knowledgeable, helpful  and friendly.   Truly enjoys his job which makes for a great experience.

name: Txoojvam T.
quote: Very friendly guy that can take you to where you will never be disappointed in fishing in Florida.

name: Kly
quote: 5 star! Great experience! Frankie is very knowledgeable and puts you on the fish, will definitely book again.

name: Kazuo D.
quote: Great trip with lots of lip rippin!

name: Tyelyn B.
quote: Best charter trip with Frankie as our captain!
